verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents an IPC interface through the `alacritty msg` subcommand and a config option to offer it. The only documented use is opening new windows with `alacritty msg create-window`, which covers the window-opening part of the story. The runtime probe could not exercise `alacritty msg` because macOS installation failed, so this neither confirms nor contradicts the capability. Missing for 10: documented ability to send text/input to a terminal via CLI/IPC, documented ability to query terminal state, in-depth IPC reference docs, hands-on or independent corroboration of the msg interface.
